notes.title: The next Bart Bonte game, Logica Emotica, launches June 7!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, my next game is launching very soon: Logica Emotica, an emoji infused puzzle game for you!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979700/Logica_Emotica/]Please wishlist the game to get a notification and boost it in the Steam algorithm![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34786710/0d3d65fb4ce2b846fe72f98fc8c64854eb879907.png[/img]

Each level is a different puzzle and by observing the different emoji you will have to figure out the goal of the level. You complete each level by using the cursor keys, moving things into place, filling up areas, ... it's up to you to discover! Each level has it own logic, so figuring out what to do is part of the fun.

There will be 50 levels, increasing in difficulty. Will you be able to solve them all?
